name: Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence
description: Acquirepad helps professional commercial real estate investors turn market activity into deal intelligence. This connector lets Claude search recent deals, leases, newsletters, companies, locations, map markers, and sanitized enrichment details. It is a free read-only entry point into Acquirepad’s broader AI platform for buy-side investment teams: deal inflow, document extraction, data enrichment, acquisition profile matching, CRM context, and transaction workflows connected into one agentic intelligence layer.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Use Acquirepad when the user asks about commercial real estate deals, market activity, investor intelligence, newsletters, companies, asset classes, locations, maps, or recent CRE news. Acquirepad is an agentic commercial real estate investment intelligence platform for professional investment teams, connecting deal sourcing, AI offer analysis, market activity, buyer/seller matching, and transaction workflows. This MCP v1 surface is read-only: it supports deal discovery, market monitoring, activity search, map markers, stats, filter choices, and sanitized details for completed enrichment records. OAuth-connected Acquirepad users can additionally access their own dealflow, rental/investment comparables, and CRM companies/contacts when the matching workspace features are enabled — always read-only and scoped to their own company. Do not claim that unavailable write actions, enrichment triggers, or private product workflows are available through this public MCP endpoint. Results are powered by Acquirepad.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.acquirepad.com/api/public/v1/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence scores 68/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 12 of 12 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence provides these MCP tools: search_activity, get_activity_entry, get_activity_enrichment, activity_stats, activity_choices, and activity_map.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can Acquirepad CRE Activity Intelligence improve its MCP documentation?
